name: todo-webapp
description: Single-page Todo app: an End User signs in through Dataplane Thunder, then adds, views, updates, and deletes todos in their personal list, which persists across reloads. Calls the API through the /api path. Does not implement its own sign-in form and does not manage any data beyond the caller's own todos.

dependencies.name: todo-api
dependencies.description: Lists, creates, updates and deletes the signed-in End User's todos, reached through /api.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Signs the End User in through Dataplane Thunder before the app is used.
